summary: QC inspection failed: Coconut Oil moisture 23.1% exceeds 14% contract threshold
root_cause: Supplier stored product in non-climate-controlled warehouse during heavy monsoon. Moisture absorbed during storage exceeded contract limits. SGS inspection found moisture 23.1%, aflatoxin 18ppb — both exceeding contracted thresholds.

remediation_steps.description: Notify buyer and supplier of QC failure findings
remediation_steps.result: Email notifications sent to both parties

remediation_steps.description: Assess if product can be reworked within acceptable timeline and cost
remediation_steps.result: HITL escalation created for operator assessment

remediation_steps.description: If reworkable: rebook SGS for re-inspection after remediation
If not reworkable: transition deal to DISPUTE and initiate refund process
